definitions.explanation: The final period of the year, especially December.
The time when day ends and night begins.

examples.japanese: {年|とし}の{暮|く}れは{忙|いそが}しい。
examples.english: The end of the year is busy.

examples.japanese: {日|ひ}{暮|ぐ}れまでに{帰|かえ}る。

notes:
{暮|く}れ refers to endings - of the year or the day.

YEAR-END USAGE:
- {年|とし}の{暮|く}れ (year end)
- {暮|く}れの{挨拶|あいさつ} (year-end greetings)
- {暮|く}れも{押|お}し{迫|せま}る (year-end approaches)

DAY-END USAGE:
- {日|ひ}{暮|ぐ}れ (dusk, sunset)
- {夕|ゆう}{暮|ぐ}れ (evening, dusk)

SEASONAL EXPRESSIONS:
- {暮|く}れから{正月|しょうがつ} (from year-end through New Year)
- お{歳暮|せいぼ} (year-end gift)

CONTRAST:
- {暮|く}れ (end of year/day)
- {明|あ}け (beginning, dawn)
